hints.tr: Ayın numarası için `enumerate(values)`. Aşılma: `abs(value - reference) > limit`.
hints.en: For the month's number, `enumerate(values)`. Crossing: `abs(value - reference) > limit`.

hints.tr: Aşıldıysa `streak += 1`, aşılmadıysa `streak = 0`; sonra `if streak >= patience: alerts.append(month)`.
hints.en: If crossed, `streak += 1`, otherwise `streak = 0`; then `if streak >= patience: alerts.append(month)`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def alert_months(values, reference, limit, patience):
    alerts = []
    streak = 0
    for month, value in enumerate(values):
        if abs(value - reference) > limit:
            streak += 1
        else:
            streak = 0
        if streak >= patience:
            alerts.append(month)
    return alerts


rates = [0.20, 0.29, 0.34, 0.39, 0.50, 0.51, 0.59, 0.59]
print(alert_months(rates, rates[0], 0.1, 2))
print(alert_months(rates, rates[0], 0.1, 3))
print(alert_months([0.2, 0.35, 0.2, 0.35], 0.2, 0.1, 2))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def alert_months(values, reference, limit, patience):
    alerts = []
    streak = 0
    for month, value in enumerate(values):
        if abs(value - reference) > limit:
            streak += 1
        else:
            streak = 0
        if streak >= patience:
            alerts.append(month)
    return alerts


rates = [0.20, 0.29, 0.34, 0.39, 0.50, 0.51, 0.59, 0.59]
print(alert_months(rates, rates[0], 0.1, 2))
print(alert_months(rates, rates[0], 0.1, 3))
print(alert_months([0.2, 0.35, 0.2, 0.35], 0.2, 0.1, 2))
```
